stops.name: Battery Spencer
stops.blurb: Marin postcard of the bridge and city.
stops.caution: Parking tight at sunset.

stops.name: Hawk Hill
stops.blurb: Higher Marin view with ocean and bridge.

stops.name: Mount Tamalpais East Peak
stops.blurb: Short hike to the lookout. Crazy inversion sunsets.
stops.caution: Cash lot fee.

stops.name: Trojan Point, Mount Tam
stops.blurb: Quieter Tam sunset pullout.
stops.caution: Arrive before golden hour.

stops.name: Point Bonita Lighthouse
stops.blurb: Handrail through a rock tunnel, then the 1855 lighthouse on a knife of land.
stops.caution: Hours are short. The bridge closes in wind.

stops.name: Rodeo Beach
stops.blurb: Headlands cove, not Stinson. Dark sand, bunkers on the ridge.
stops.caution: Fog and a steep lot. Stay off the rocks in swell.

stops.name: Muir Woods National Monument
stops.blurb: Old-growth redwoods twenty minutes from the bridge. The boardwalk is the walk.
stops.caution: Parking and shuttle are reservation-only.

stops.name: Muir Beach Overlook
stops.blurb: WWII spots and a straight drop to the Pacific. Quieter than the woods.
stops.caution: Cliff edge. Keep off the gun-battery roofs.

stops.name: Stinson Beach
stops.blurb: Marin's long sand. Highway 1 is the show on the way in.
stops.caution: Weekend lot fills before noon.

stops.name: Angel Island Immigration Station
stops.blurb: The West Coast Ellis Island. Poems carved in the barracks walls.
stops.caution: Ferry from Tiburon. Station is a hike or tram from the dock.

stops.name: Point Reyes Lighthouse
stops.blurb: 1870 light on the windiest point in the park. Stairs down the cliff.
stops.caution: Three hundred steps. Closes in high wind. Long drive on Sir Francis Drake.

stops.name: Albany Bulb
stops.blurb: Landfill peninsula with junk sculpture and a skyline across the Bay.
stops.caution: Unpaved. Dogs off-leash. Art moves; do not take it.

stops.name: Treasure Island vista
stops.blurb: The city skyline from the middle of the Bay. Free, and still skipped.
stops.caution: Wind. Stay on the public side of the Job Corps fence.

stops.name: Berkeley Rose Garden
stops.blurb: Terraced roses and a Bay view. Peak bloom is May.
stops.caution: Street parking on Euclid. The courts below are loud.

stops.name: Lake Merritt
stops.blurb: Saltwater lake in downtown Oakland. Walk the necklace, not the freeway.
stops.caution: Go at golden hour. Night is a different park.

stops.name: Fort Point
stops.blurb: Brick Civil War fort directly under the Golden Gate. The underside is the shot.
stops.caution: Check open hours. Wave spray on the seawall.

stops.name: Tilden Inspiration Point
stops.blurb: East Bay ridge looking west at the Gate. Wildcat Canyon Road, not the campus.
stops.caution: The lot fills on clear weekends. No water at the overlook.

stops.name: Palace of Fine Arts
stops.blurb: 1915 rotunda and lagoon. The postcard is free; the inside is a venue.
stops.caution: Wedding traffic on weekends.

stops.name: Mensho Tokyo SF
stops.blurb: Michelin Guide listed since 2017. Tori paitan that still costs like dinner.
stops.caution: Dinner only. Line on weekends.

stops.name: Mount Diablo Summit
stops.blurb: On a clear day you see Half Dome. The summit road is the point.
stops.caution: State park fee. Gates close at sunset. Watch for bikes on the descent.

stops.name: Presidio Visitor Center + Tunnel Tops
stops.blurb: GG sunset plus the bridge in frame. Stay on the SF side for the actual sun.
stops.caution: Fog happens.

stops.name: Immigrant Point Overlook
stops.blurb: West-facing Pacific sunset in the Presidio, quieter than Tunnel Tops.
stops.caution: Muni 29.

stops.name: Golden Gate Overlook
stops.blurb: SF-side postcard of the towers.

stops.name: Baker Beach
stops.blurb: Sand plus the bridge in the right-hand frame.
stops.caution: Weekday evenings.

stops.name: Sutro Baths ruins
stops.blurb: Concrete pools the Pacific took back. Pair it with Lands End.
stops.caution: Slippery. Do not climb the cave in a swell.

stops.name: Lands End Labyrinth
stops.blurb: Stone spiral with the Golden Gate in the distance.
stops.caution: Uneven rock.

stops.name: Legion of Honor
stops.blurb: Lincoln Park museum aimed at the Gate. Rodin in the court.
stops.caution: Closed Monday. Pair with Lands End, not a downtown museum day.

stops.name: Grand View Park
stops.blurb: West-facing sunset without Twin Peaks vans.
stops.caution: Go early.

stops.name: Japanese Tea Garden
stops.blurb: 1894 garden inside Golden Gate Park. Drum bridge, tea house, koi.
stops.caution: Ticketed. Go at open. Pair with the de Young lawn, not the parking garage fight.

stops.name: 16th Avenue Tiled Steps
stops.blurb: Mosaic stairs that dump you at Grand View.

stops.name: Twin Peaks
stops.blurb: 360 city view. Noisy at sunset.

stops.name: Swan Oyster Depot
stops.blurb: Counter seafood since 1912.
stops.caution: Line early.

stops.name: San Tung
stops.blurb: Dry-fried wings on Irving.

stops.name: Ferry Building Marketplace
stops.blurb: Clock tower, oysters, and the Embarcadero. Saturday farmers market is the one.
stops.caution: Tourist hours. Go early or just after work.

stops.name: Alamo Square Painted Ladies
stops.blurb: Steiner Street Victorians with the downtown stack behind them.
stops.caution: The park, not the porches. Stay off private stairs.

stops.name: Coit Tower
stops.blurb: Telegraph Hill column. The 1934 murals are the indoor take.
stops.caution: Filbert steps if the lot is full. Elevator is ticketed.

stops.name: Bernal Heights Park
stops.blurb: Grass hill, 360 of the city, no Twin Peaks vans.
stops.caution: Dirt road to the top. Dogs off-leash by custom.

stops.name: El Farolito
stops.blurb: Mission burrito at 24th and Mission. Super burrito, no flourishes.
stops.caution: Cash-friendly late night. The line is the review.

stops.name: Fort Funston
stops.blurb: Hang-glider bluff at the south end of the city. Ice plant, dogs, and the drop.
stops.caution: Cliff edges crumble. Stay behind the fence.

stops.name: Mori Point
stops.blurb: GGNRA bluff south of the city. Boardwalk through the marsh, then the point.
stops.caution: Stay on the new trail. The old farm road is gone.

stops.name: Devil's Slide Trail
stops.blurb: The old Highway 1, now a clifftop walk. Tunnel is for cars; this is for the view.
stops.caution: Fog and bikes. No cars on the trail.

stops.name: Point Montara Lighthouse
stops.blurb: 1875 light on the bluff between Devil's Slide and Half Moon Bay. Hostel on the grounds.
stops.caution: Grounds, not the tower. Foghorn is loud. Park in the hostel lot only if signed.

stops.name: Pillar Point + Mavericks
stops.blurb: Harbor, then the Mavericks headland. Winter swell is the famous one.
stops.caution: Do not climb the jetty in a set. Harbor parking is easier than the point.

stops.name: Fitzgerald Marine Reserve
stops.blurb: Tidepools on a reef, not a beach day. Low tide is the whole stop.
stops.caution: Stay off the reef living things. Check the tide. Harbor seals haul out — give space.

stops.name: Pigeon Point Light Station
stops.blurb: 115-foot lighthouse on Highway 1. Tied for tallest on the West Coast.
stops.caution: Tower tours are limited. The grounds and hostel stay open.

stops.name: Año Nuevo State Park
stops.blurb: Elephant seal colony on the point. Winter is guided walks only.
stops.caution: Reserve the guided walk Dec–March. Stay behind the rope.

stops.name: Filoli Historic House
stops.blurb: 1917 country estate in the folds above the Peninsula. Gardens are the walk.
stops.caution: Ticketed. Timed entry. Not a highway pullout — it is a detour inland.

stops.name: Hoover Tower
stops.blurb: Stanford's 285-foot campanile. The observation deck is the campus grid.
stops.caution: Campus parking is paid. The deck keeps hours. Do not block Palm Drive.

stops.name: Computer History Museum
stops.blurb: Babbage to the Google rack. The Difference Engine is the room.
stops.caution: Closed Tuesday. Pair with Shoreline, not a highway stop.

stops.name: San Jose Japantown
stops.blurb: One of three remaining US Japantowns.

stops.name: San Jose Municipal Rose Garden
stops.blurb: Free roses and a soft South Bay sunset.

stops.name: Almaden Quicksilver County Park
stops.blurb: Old mine hills and ridge sunsets.

stops.name: Hue
stops.blurb: Central Vietnamese rice cakes in a strip mall.

stops.name: Japanese Friendship Garden
stops.blurb: Kelley Park koi ponds, sister to Okayama. Free, and still a neighborhood garden.
stops.caution: Pair with Japantown, not the freeway loop.

stops.name: Winchester Mystery House
stops.blurb: Sarah Winchester's maze. Stairs to ceilings, a tourist classic on purpose.
stops.caution: Ticketed tour. The garden is not a free substitute.

stops.name: Hakone Estate and Gardens
stops.blurb: Hillside Japanese garden from 1915. Tea house, bamboo, and a quiet pond.
stops.caution: Ticketed. Hill is steep; wear real shoes.

stops.name: Los Gatos Town Plaza
stops.blurb: Creek-town main street at the foot of the Santa Cruz Mountains. Walk Santa Cruz Avenue.
stops.caution: Weekend parking is a hunt. This is the pause before Highway 17.

stops.name: Henry Cowell Redwoods
stops.blurb: Old-growth loop in the San Lorenzo valley. Quieter than Muir Woods.
stops.caution: Day-use fee. The Redwood Grove loop, not the whole mountain.

stops.name: Mystery Spot
stops.blurb: 1949 gravity house in the redwoods. Balls roll uphill. That's the gag.
stops.caution: Timed tickets. The hill road is one-lane. Do not skip the reservation.

stops.name: Wilder Ranch State Park
stops.blurb: Coast dairy ranch west of town. Bluff trail, not the Boardwalk.
stops.caution: Day-use fee. Bikes on the ranch roads.

stops.name: West Cliff Drive + Steamer Lane
stops.blurb: West-facing Santa Cruz sunset path.

stops.name: Natural Bridges State Beach
stops.blurb: Rock arch and monarch grove.
stops.caution: Day-use fee.

stops.name: Santa Cruz Beach Boardwalk
stops.blurb: 1911 Giant Dipper and the last beach amusement park on the West Coast.
stops.caution: Summer nights are packed. The Dipper is wooden — that's the ride.

stops.name: Shark Fin Cove
stops.blurb: Hidden Highway 1 cove.
stops.caution: Steep path.

stops.name: Capitola Village
stops.blurb: Painted houses on a cove east of Santa Cruz. The beach is the color.
stops.caution: Weekend parking is a fight. Walk in from the upper lots.

stops.name: Elkhorn Slough
stops.blurb: Estuary north of Monterey. Otters, leopard sharks, and a boardwalk over pickleweed.
stops.caution: Visitor center on Elkhorn Road. Kayaks launch at Moss Landing, not the reserve lot.

stops.name: 17-Mile Drive + Lone Cypress
stops.blurb: Toll loop. Bike it if you can.
stops.caution: Gate fee.

stops.name: Spanish Bay sunset + bagpiper
stops.blurb: Dune fire pits and a piper at dusk.
stops.caution: Time it to sunset.

stops.name: Point Lobos State Natural Reserve
stops.blurb: Cypress Grove and otters. Go at open.
stops.caution: Lot fills.

stops.name: Carmel Beach
stops.blurb: White sand at the foot of Ocean Avenue.

stops.name: Cannery Row
stops.blurb: Steinbeck's street, now the walk to the Aquarium. The history is in the brick, not the T-shirts.
stops.caution: Pair with the Aquarium. Street parking is a fight after 11.

stops.name: Monterey Bay Aquarium
stops.blurb: The indoor stop that earns the ticket.
stops.caution: Buy ahead.

stops.name: Point Pinos Lighthouse
stops.blurb: 1855 light, oldest still working on the West Coast. Golf course on three sides.
stops.caution: Limited interior hours. The point is the stop even when the door is locked.

stops.name: Lover's Point
stops.blurb: Pacific Grove pocket park. Otters, kayaks, and a west-facing sunset.
stops.caution: The cove rocks are slick. Stay off the sea wall in swell.

stops.name: Carmel Mission
stops.blurb: Serra's basilica, courtyard, and the old quadrangle. The quiet stop in Carmel.
stops.caution: Mass hours. Dress for a church, not the beach.

stops.name: Garrapata Bluff Trail
stops.blurb: North Big Sur cliffs with no gift shop.
stops.caution: Stay on trail.

stops.name: Bixby Creek Bridge
stops.blurb: Use the signed north turnout.
stops.caution: Do not stop on the span.

stops.name: Point Sur Lightstation
stops.blurb: 1889 light on a volcanic rock. You only go up with a tour.
stops.caution: Guided walks, not a pullout. Check the volunteer schedule before you wait at the gate.

stops.name: Andrew Molera State Park
stops.blurb: Beach via a footbridge, no lodge. The Big Sur River meets the sand here.
stops.caution: Walk-in. Lot fee. The bridge goes out in floods.

stops.name: Nepenthe
stops.blurb: Cliff restaurant whose view is the menu.
stops.caution: Wait for a deck table.

stops.name: Henry Miller Memorial Library
stops.blurb: Bookstore and yard under the redwoods, next to Nepenthe. Not a quiet library.
stops.caution: Hours vary. Park on the highway shoulder with care.

stops.name: Pfeiffer Beach
stops.blurb: Purple sand and the sunset keyhole. Turn on Sycamore Canyon Road.
stops.caution: Narrow road.

stops.name: McWay Falls
stops.blurb: Tidefall you cannot see from the highway.
stops.caution: Overlook only.

stops.name: Limekiln State Park
stops.blurb: Redwoods, a beach, and the kilns in one short canyon south of McWay.
stops.caution: Day-use fee. The waterfall trail is short. Do not climb the kilns.
